t: This is the Peacock Theatre, a West End theatre on Portugal Street, near Aldwych. It seats nine hundred and ninety-nine people. The building is owned by the London School of Economics and forms part of its campus, so besides performances it hosts lectures, public talks, conferences, political speeches and open days. It was designed by Bertie Crewe, one of the leading English theatre architects during the boom years between 1885 and 1915.
